Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood walkthrough (ICS deep link missing) — proposed fix

Thanks for the ping — this is a known fragile case (ICS generator + organizer alias forwarding). Short summary and proposal:

Root cause (short): the calendar export we're producing includes a UID but when the event is *forwarded* or imported into some Exchange/GCal tenant flows the X-ALT-DESC/deep-link line gets stripped if the organizer is a group alias or a third-party proxy. If the organizer is a specific Redwood rep's account the deep-link is preserved.

Proposed plan (low-risk):
- I will regenerate the ICS with Logan set explicitly as the organizer (ics-regenerated.ics attached).
- Include a plain-text backup Zoom link inside the event body (backup-zoom-link.txt attached) and in the event description so clients that don't read the deep-link fallback to Zoom.
- Add a 5-minute pre-join buffer and host-claim instructions (so IT Ops can pre-authorize).

If their IT team still needs an alternate format we can also provide a calendar-forward token (one-click re-issue) — but start with the regenerated ICS + Zoom fallback.

Next steps: Logan, can you re-send the invite to Sophie and to itops@novellbio.com with the new ICS and include the zoom fallback in the description? I’ll monitor.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
